name: @solana/mosaic-sdk
description: SDK for Mosaic with helper functions for issuance and management of any token

_dependencyNotes.solanaKitV7: This SDK targets the Solana Kit v7 ecosystem (@solana/kit@^7, @solana/sysvars@^7). @solana-program/system and @solana-program/memo are on their kit-v7-native releases (0.13.0 / 0.12.0). @solana-program/token-2022 is the published 0.15.0 (kit-v7-native) — NO patch. token-2022 must be >=0.13.0 on kit v7 because 0.12.0's compiled code imports getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption from @solana/kit, which kit v7 removed; and >=0.15.0 for this SDK specifically, because 0.15.0 is the first published release carrying the confidential mint/burn InstructionPlan helpers (upstreamed in https://github.com/solana-program/token-2022/pull/1357, shipped 2026-08-13). EVERY confidential helper this SDK consumes now comes from the @solana-program/token-2022/confidential subpath: transfer/withdraw/configure/apply InstructionPlan helpers, PR #1269 (getConfidentialTransferInstructionPlan resolves the auditor from an optional mintAccount) and — as of 0.15.0 — getConfidentialMintInstructionPlan/getConfidentialBurnInstructionPlan/getPermissionedConfidentialBurnInstructionPlan/getUpdateConfidentialMintBurnDecryptableSupplyInstructionFromSupply. The former local mint/burn proof implementation (confidential/mint-burn-plan.ts + mint-burn-proof.ts + ciphertext-math.ts, on @noble/curves) is DELETED and @noble/curves is dropped — it is now an internal token-2022 dependency. NOT yet adopted from 0.15.0 (deliberate follow-ups): getEmptyConfidentialTransferAccountInstructionPlan, which would retire the local zero-ciphertext plumbing in confidential/empty-account.ts + proof.ts, and the get*WithRecordInstructionPlan variants that stage proofs in an SPL Record account instead of a context-state account. Key derivation is the one confidential primitive NOT taken from token-2022: confidential/keys.ts calls @solana/zk-sdk's ConfidentialKeys.signerMessage/fromSignature directly, so the wallet-only account derivation and Mosaic's own seeded deriveConfidentialSupplyKeys share a single code path — see the zkSdkV052 note. @solana/zk-sdk is pinned to exactly 0.5.2 (token-2022 0.15.0 declares it as an optional peer at ^0.5.1, which 0.5.2 satisfies). The exact pin — mirrored by the root override — exists to guarantee exactly ONE resolved zk-sdk copy in the tree: a second copy instantiates a second WASM module and breaks class identity with `expected instance of ElGamalKeypair`. 0.5.2 is packaging-only over 0.5.1 (dist/* byte-identical): it adds the upstream `node` condition on ./bundler plus a condition-aware root `.` export (https://github.com/solana-program/zk-elgamal-proof/pull/519), which retired this repo's former `pnpm patch` on zk-sdk and the jest ./bundler remap. 0.5.x remains purely additive over 0.4.2 (it only adds a ConfidentialKeys class, which does not collide with this SDK's same-named type since zk-sdk is re-exported only through the separate ./_zk subpath). @solana-program/zk-elgamal-proof is ^0.3.2 (up from 0.1.0, which token-2022 0.15.0 no longer matches): every symbol confidential/proof.ts imports still exists, and 0.3.2 declares kit ^7 as its peer so it no longer needs the root override to escape a kit <=6 range. @solana/token-acl-sdk@0.4.0 declares an exact token-2022 0.12.0 dependency, forced up to 0.15.0 by the root override — safe because it only uses stable core exports (TOKEN_2022_PROGRAM_ADDRESS, getMintDecoder, ATA/metadata helpers, AccountState, Mint), unchanged across 0.10-0.15. The token-acl SDKs declare kit <=6 peer ranges but run correctly on kit v7 (they only touch codecs/signers/addresses; v7's only breaking changes — a type-only codec-union return-type widening, ReactiveStreamStore.connect(), a new instruction-planning error — are not exercised) and are forced onto v7 via the root @solana/kit + @solana/* overrides. See: https://github.com/anza-xyz/kit
_dependencyNotes.zkSdkV052: @solana/zk-sdk bumped 0.4.2 -> 0.5.2 (HOO-1595): 0.5.x adds the `ConfidentialKeys` class (signerMessage/fromSignature yielding both the ElGamal keypair and AES key from one signature), purely additive over 0.4.2. Confidential key derivation now uses `ConfidentialKeys.signerMessage(new Uint8Array(0))` directly in keys.ts — a wallet-only scheme with no seed — instead of the old two-call `ElGamalSecretKey`/`AeKey` derivation via upstream's `deriveElGamalKeypairForOwnerMint`/`deriveAeKeyForOwnerMint`, and instead of this repo's former `(owner, mint)`-seeded `deriveConfidentialKeysForOwnerMint` (both removed). token-2022 0.15.0 ships its own `deriveConfidentialKeys` wrapper over the same scheme; this SDK calls zk-sdk directly instead so that the wallet-only account derivation and Mosaic's own `deriveConfidentialSupplyKeys` (seeded under the `mosaic-conf-supply/v1` domain tag, for ConfidentialMintBurn supply keys, which upstream has no equivalent of) share one implementation. The root package.json override and apps/app's own zk-sdk dependency must stay on the exact same 0.5.2 — a second resolved copy instantiates a second WASM module and breaks `instanceof` class identity.
